environment: Two disposable in-memory PGlite PostgreSQL databases plus a temporary file directory
limitations: Real pg_dump/snapshot sharing was substituted with the known fixture schema.
This is not a full Supabase schema/auth/policy/application recovery rehearsal.

checks.name: Actual PostgreSQL fixture rows exported in a read-only transaction
All records, SOP revisions, signatures, comments and work-instruction releases match
Step order and BOM quantities retained
Restored foreign-key constraints reject broken references
Original media and thumbnail bytes match
Source fixture records unchanged after export and recovery
Invalid authentication tag causes zero recovery callbacks
Existing verified archive preserved on collision
unavailable storage export never produces a verified archive
interrupted storage export never produces a verified archive
changed storage export never produces a verified archive
All business fixture rows unchanged after every failure simulation
